notes: A 10-trip metro ticket costs 12.20 EUR; the airport is 30 minutes by metro or Cercanías. Toledo and Segovia are 30 minutes by AVE (from Atocha or Chamartín); buy tickets in advance.
The Prado, the Palace and the Reina Sofía need timed online tickets. The Prado is free 18:00-20:00 and the Reina on Saturday afternoons (expect queues).
Summer reaches 35-40°C: visit museums at midday and rooftop terraces (azoteas) at night, and eat dinner at 22:00. In August locals are on holiday and some bars close.
Tapas cost 2-4 EUR, a menú del día 13-16 EUR and cochinillo 30-40 EUR; churros at San Ginés cost 5 EUR. Round up the bill instead of tipping.
Visit the Rastro on a Sunday morning; Lavapiés and Malasaña are best in the evening. Watch for pickpockets around Sol and on the metro.
If Real Madrid are playing, book tickets months ahead; stadium tours run every day.

stops.name: Museo del Prado
stops.tips: Velázquez's Las Meninas, Goya, Bosch. Book a timed slot online (15 EUR); entry is free 18:00-20:00 but crowded.

stops.name: Parque del Retiro
stops.tips: The lake (rowing boats 6 EUR), the Crystal Palace and the Fallen Angel statue.

stops.name: Casa Alberto
stops.tips: A tavern dating from 1827 in Huertas; try the rabo de toro (oxtail stew) and vermouth.

stops.name: Museo Reina Sofía
stops.tips: Picasso's Guernica; free on Saturdays after 14:30.

stops.name: Barrio de las Letras
stops.tips: Cervantes' neighbourhood, with verses written in the streets, and Plaza Santa Ana.

backups.name: Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza
backups.tips: The third of the Golden Triangle of Art museums; a swap for the Reina Sofía.

backups.name: Mercado de San Miguel
backups.tips: Tapas stalls in an iron-and-glass market hall; touristy but worth seeing.

days.theme: Habsburg Madrid and the Royal Palace

stops.name: Plaza Mayor
stops.tips: The square is empty in the morning; have a bocadillo de calamares (fried squid sandwich) at Casa Rúa.

stops.name: Royal Palace of Madrid
stops.tips: Europe's largest palace. Book a timed slot online; see the Throne Room and the Sabatini Gardens.

stops.name: Almudena Cathedral
stops.tips: Opposite the palace; look up at the colourful ceiling.

stops.name: Chocolatería San Ginés
stops.tips: Churros con chocolate, served 24 hours a day since 1894.

stops.name: La Latina Cava Baja Tapas
stops.tips: A tapas crawl along Cava Baja: Casa Lucio (huevos rotos, broken fried eggs), Juana la Loca (tortilla) and Txirimiri.

backups.name: Casa Botín
backups.tips: The world's oldest restaurant (1725); order the cochinillo (roast suckling pig) and book ahead.

backups.name: Temple of Debod
backups.tips: An Egyptian temple famed for its sunsets; an alternative to the cathedral.

stops.name: Gran Vía
stops.tips: Madrid's Broadway, with the Metropolis Building and the Schweppes sign.

stops.name: Malasaña Streets
stops.tips: Vintage shops and record stores; Plaza del Dos de Mayo.

stops.name: Mercado de San Ildefonso
stops.tips: A street-food market on Fuencarral.

stops.name: Chueca
stops.tips: A colourful neighbourhood; head up to the rooftop bar at Mercado de San Antón.

stops.name: Círculo de Bellas Artes Terrace
stops.tips: A rooftop terrace above Gran Vía; sunset views and Calle de Alcalá.

backups.name: Museo de Historia de Madrid
backups.tips: The city history museum in Malasaña; free entry.

stops.name: Toledo Cathedral
stops.tips: AVE train from Atocha takes 33 minutes. Spain's largest Gothic cathedral, with works by El Greco.

stops.name: Church of Santo Tomé
stops.tips: El Greco's The Burial of the Count of Orgaz.

stops.name: Synagogue of Santa María la Blanca
stops.tips: A Mudéjar synagogue in the Jewish quarter.

stops.name: Cervecería El Trébol
stops.tips: A local spot in Toledo for bombas (potato croquettes) and carcamusas (pork and tomato stew).

stops.name: Mirador del Valle
stops.tips: The Toledo skyline from across the river. Take the tourist bus or a taxi, and head back by 17:00.

backups.name: Alcázar of Toledo
backups.tips: An army museum with city views; an alternative to the viewpoint.

stops.name: Aqueduct of Segovia
stops.tips: AVE takes 27 minutes. A 2,000-year-old Roman aqueduct built without mortar, 28 m high.

stops.name: Segovia Cathedral
stops.tips: The last Gothic cathedral built in Spain; it stands on Plaza Mayor.

stops.name: Alcázar of Segovia
stops.tips: Said to have inspired Disney's castle; the tower has 152 steps.

stops.name: Mesón de Cándido
stops.tips: Serving cochinillo (suckling pig) beneath the aqueduct since 1898; the pig is carved with a plate.

stops.name: Mirador de la Pradera de San Marcos
stops.tips: The Alcázar seen like a ship's prow, from the riverside.

backups.name: Royal Site of La Granja de San Ildefonso
backups.tips: A Versailles-style palace 11 km from Segovia; an alternative to the viewpoint.

stops.name: Sorolla Museum
stops.tips: The painter's home, with an Andalusian-style garden; quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Calle Serrano, Barrio de Salamanca
stops.tips: A luxury shopping street; Platea is nearby for gastronomy and theatre.

stops.name: Platea Madrid
stops.tips: A food market in a former cinema, near Colón.

stops.name: Santiago Bernabéu Stadium Tour
stops.tips: The Real Madrid museum and stadium tour; go if there is no match.

stops.name: National Archaeological Museum
stops.tips: Home to the Lady of Elche; in Salamanca, a good refuge from the heat.

backups.name: Lhardy
backups.tips: A restaurant dating from 1839; cocido madrileño (Madrid chickpea stew), Monday to Wednesday.

backups.name: Parque de El Capricho
backups.tips: A romantic park, open at weekends; an alternative to the stadium.

days.theme: Rastro and Lavapiés: a gentle farewell

stops.name: El Rastro
stops.tips: A huge flea market on Sundays (Ribera de Curtidores); on other days, antique shops.

stops.name: Lavapiés
stops.tips: A multicultural neighbourhood with murals and the Tabacalera.

stops.name: Casa Revuelta
stops.tips: Known for its bacalao rebozado (battered cod) tapa; a standing-room bar by the Rastro, open since 1966.

stops.name: Puerta del Sol Kilometre Zero
stops.tips: Spain's zero point and the Bear statue. Take the metro to Atocha; the airport is 30 minutes by Cercanías.

backups.name: Taberna La Concha
backups.tips: Vermouth and tapas in La Latina.

backups.name: Museo Cerralbo
backups.tips: An aristocrat's mansion; an alternative to Lavapiés.
